== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Meet the Emissary outside of [[Venta Cemetery (outpost)|Venta Cemetery]].
* Search for the [[Gum Drops, the Noble Steed|invisible pony]].
*Keep searching for the invisible pony.
*That pony's got to be around here somewhere.
*Where the heck is this stupid pony?!
*When I find this pony, Joko's minions are the last thing it should be worried about.
*Defeat [[Palawa Joko]]'s Elite Pony-Hunting Squad.
* See Emissary of King Thorn of Kryta for your reward.

=== Reward ===
*2,000 [[Experience]]
*1,000 [[Gold]]
*50 [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s

== Walkthrough ==
Start from Venta Cemetery and exit to [[Turai's Procession]]. Follow the path to initiate dialogue by the [[Emissary of King Thorn of Kryta]]. After he tells you about the "peripheral pony particles" and his plan to capture [[Gum Drops, the Noble Steed]], continue to the first marker on the map (on the right of this page). You'll encounter [[Awakened]] mobs on the path throughout this quest.

After attempting to catch Gum Drops for the first time, he will run away; at which point you should continue to the second marker. After reaching the second marker, Gum Drops will run away again. Proceed to the third marker on the map. When you reach him the third time, he will slip away ''yet again''. Follow the path to reach the fourth marker on the map.

At the fourth marker, Gum Drops will run away again for the final time. Proceed in the direction of Gate of Desolation, and you will encounter Palawa Joko's Elite Pony-Hunting Squad, who have captured Gum Drops. After a little dialogue, the initially non-hostile Krastos and his group will turn hostile, and attack your party. When you kill his group, watch the dialogue between the Emissary and Gum Drops and the quest will update and be complete. Return to the Emissary of King Thorn of Kryta in [[Kamadan]] to complete the quest.

== Notes ==
* The [[undead]] [[spawn]]ed by this quest use their [[Scarred Psyche]] builds instead of their regular Nightfall/[[The Desolation]] builds.
* The PON-3 Detector is tied to the Emissary's location. If he gets stuck on eg. a resurrection shrine, the meter doesn't progress even if the rest of your party goes and stands next to Gum Drops.
{{Bug|The quest does not indicate on the [[compass]] or [[World Map]] to go to Kamadan for the reward.}}

== Trivia ==
*The quest name and much of its dialogue are references to the television show [[w:My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic|My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic]] and its fanbase.
** ''"Of all the worst possible things that could happen, this is... The. Worst. Possible. Thing!"'', ''"I'll catch that pony in ten seconds flat!"'', ''"You're going to... *wheeze* LOVE ME!"'', ''"When some pony tries to run, show them that you're fun."'', and ''"If you harm one invisible hair on that pony's head, I'll make you wish you had never been reanimated!"'' are paraphrased versions of popular quotes from the show.
** ''"I'm told that Gum Drops has a mark shaped like a pumpkin on his flank"'' is a reference to a pony's cutie mark on its flank that signifies its special talent.
** (DJ) "PON-3" is the name of a popular minor character in the show.
** ''"Confound this pony! It's driving me to insanity!"'' refers to "Confound these ponies, they drive me to drink!", a phrase commonly used by the fanbase to describe the process of becoming a fan of the show.
** The reward dialogue references the Halloween episode, namely the memetic line "The fun has been doubled!"
** Krastos is a reference to a [[w:NPR|NPR]] interview with former US president [[w:Bill Clinton|Bill Clinton]]. A multiple-choice question about the main villain of Friendship is Magic included the option "Krastos the Glue Maker".
*This quest was introduced in [[Halloween 2012]].
